commit.message:
Slice platform-app-icon-badge: unread badge on the app/taskbar icon (#243)

Linux: Unity com.canonical.Unity.LauncherEntry Update D-Bus signal
(count/count-visible) via dbus-send, change-gated from the 1s UI-thread
sync timer; count reuses tray::badge_count (BadgePrefs semantics), no new
deps, silent no-op off Linux / without a session bus.

Co-authored-by: shinycake <shinycake@users.noreply.github.com>

Slice msg-richtext-inline-media: inline photos/videos in the rich-text composer (#226)

* Slice msg-richtext-inline-media: inline photos/videos in the rich-text composer

* Fix text_char_len for new Photo/Video blocks (exhaustive match from #216)

* fmt: cargo fmt --all

* fix: close for loop in inline-media attachment conversion

---------

Co-authored-by: shinycake <shinycake@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Muse <muse@hatch>

infra: exact M1 run tracking + hosted macOS fallback workflow (#233)

* infra: exact M1 run tracking — unique run-name per dispatch + fail-fast SHA assertion

* infra: hosted macOS smoke fallback workflow for when the M1 runner is offline

* Address adversarial review: optional run_name, pin fallback actions

- quill-ui-build.yml: run_name input is now optional with a generated
  default (ref + run id, unique per run). A required run_name broke the
  standard quill-ui-build-remote dispatch path (422, no supplier).
- macos-smoke-fallback.yml: pin actions/checkout, dtolnay/rust-toolchain,
  Swatinem/rust-cache to SHAs (repo standard; @master/@v4 are mutable).

---------

Co-authored-by: shinycake <shinycake@users.noreply.github.com>

* infra: fragment-based parity docs to end README/DECISIONS conflicts

* infra: fragment-based parity docs to end README/DECISIONS conflicts

* infra: fragment-based parity docs to end README/DECISIONS conflicts

* infra: fragment-based parity docs to end README/DECISIONS conflicts

* Fail closed when the base diff can't be computed (adversarial review)

check-parity-fragments.sh swallowed git diff errors with || true,
letting a malformed-fragment PR pass the gate on a bad base ref.
Drop the swallow and fail with a clear message instead.

Co-authored-by: shinycake <shinycake@users.noreply.github.com>
ci: remove auto-merge workflow — GITHUB_TOKEN cannot call enablePullRequestAutoMerge, every run failed since #189; the merge pipeline arms auto-merge via gh CLI instead (#230)

Slice parity:msg-richtext-tables — compact bordered-grid table rendering (#224)

Tables rendered as loose flex rows with gap_2; now a compact hairline
bordered grid: tight px_2/py_1 cell padding, hairline row/cell dividers,
header row (row 0) semibold on a muted band.

Co-authored-by: shinycake <shinycake@users.noreply.github.com>

Slice parity:platform-os-notifications — verify OS dispatch, check the box (#239)

The README claimed 'no OS dispatch', but that note was stale (original
checklist #74); dispatch landed in Phase 8.1 (66440fd) and the checklist
was never updated. Verified the full path: decide_notify ->
pending_notifications -> flush_notifications every render ->
spawn_os_notification worker threads -> notify-send/osascript, with
click-to-focus on Linux. No code changes needed.

Co-authored-by: shinycake <shinycake@users.noreply.github.com>

Slice auth-multi-account (UI): Accounts dialog — list / switch / add / remove (#219)

* Slice parity:auth-multi-account (UI): Accounts dialog — list / switch / add / remove

* src/ui/accounts.rs (new): AccountsUiState + open/close/switch_account/
  add_account_named/remove_account_key + build_accounts_dialog (kit
  window.open_dialog pattern; DialogKind::Accounts). Switch uses the
  documented flow: LiveConnect::shutdown -> set_active_account ->
  start_live_connect_for_account; the existing auth UI renders the
  phone/QR/code flow for new accounts. Remove gets an inline confirm on
  non-active accounts only (the active account has no Remove button).
* src/ui/app.rs, src/ui/app_demo.rs: startup credentials kept for the app
  lifetime (cloned before bootstrap_connect) so the switcher can
  reconnect as another account; accounts_ui state field.
* src/ui/shell.rs: DialogKind::Accounts (KINDS 35 -> 36).
* src/ui/chat_list.rs: 'Accounts' entry next to the Account entry.
* Screenshot harness: ScreenshotDemo::ReadyAccounts + ready-accounts CLI
  kind + docs/screenshots/ready-accounts.png.
* README: check parity:auth-multi-account (backend PR #214 + this UI).

Gates: fmt OK; clippy --no-default-features -D warnings OK;
cargo test --no-default-features OK (25 suites, 0 failures);
cargo check --features ui OK. Full link skipped by design (check covers
the UI compile; the UI work is kit components/dialogs only).

* fixup: SecretStore key cleanup on remove + Live status on switch

* fixup: merge duplicate credentials field from #212/#219 rebase union

---------

Co-authored-by: shinycake <shinycake@users.noreply.github.com>

feat: autostart on login (parity:platform-autostart) (#222)

Linux XDG Autostart .desktop + macOS LaunchAgents plist; Windows
explicitly unsupported (no Windows CI to verify a registry write).
'Launch at login' switch section in the Appearance dialog.

Tests: desktop-file path/content, plist path/content,
enable->disable roundtrip in a sandboxed home.

Co-authored-by: shinycake <shinycake@users.noreply.github.com>

parity:platform-history-export — chat history export to JSON file (#217)

* feat: chat history export to JSON file (parity:platform-history-export)

- New src/chat_export.rs: ChatExportState (paging buffer + result),
  project_message (ParsedMessage -> {id, date, outgoing, text?, media?}),
  write_export (pretty JSON to ~/Downloads/quill-export-<title>-<unix>.json).
- Driver (connect/messages.rs): start_chat_export + pump_chat_export page
  getChatHistory (limit 100, from oldest fetched id); short page ends paging.
- Session: RequestPurpose::ExportChatHistory; messages answers append to the
  export buffer instead of view history (mirrors GetChatPreview).
- UI: ghost Export button in the chat header (live-only); poll_live pumps
  the export and surfaces completion/failure as a status note.
- Tests: 4 unit + driver paging test (100-msg page -> next page from id 901,
  short page -> done_paging, double-start refused).
- README box checked; DECISIONS.md entry.

* fixup: reviewer blockers for #217 (page-boundary dedup, export error arm, driver test)

- session_apply_messages: drop the inclusive from_message_id boundary
  message on append (matched by id) so each message exports exactly once.
- session_apply_error: ExportChatHistory arm sets failed + clears in_flight
  so a failed page surfaces in the UI and can be retried.
- driver test ingests a page containing the boundary id and asserts no dup.
- write_export: same-second re-exports get a numeric suffix (no overwrite).

---------

Co-authored-by: shinycake <shinycake@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Muse <muse@local>
